segments.opening_question_spark: If your weight was cut in half, would Earth feel the same?
segments.book_transition: A weaker pull could change how people move and how bridges carry loads.
segments.body_01: People would weigh half as much on Earth.
segments.body_02: They could jump higher and lift heavy objects more easily.
segments.body_03: A person could carry a large box with less effort.
segments.body_04: Bridges and buildings would face different forces.
segments.body_05: Some structures might need new designs.
segments.body_06: Cars and machines would move differently.
segments.body_07: Astronauts already experience very low gravity in space.
segments.body_08: A half-gravity Earth could look familiar but act differently.
segments.body_09: Many systems would need to adjust to lower weight.
segments.optional_closing: Lighter does not mean the same.
